datasets.details: Full Data from OSM can be downloaded from [Gefabrik](http://download.geofabrik.de/africa/nigeria.html) Nigeria Main Road data from OSM can also be downloaded from [WFP](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nigeria-road-network-main-roads) Nigeria Streets data from OSM can also be downloaded from [WFP] (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nigeria-road-network-streets)

lineage.description: Road network data was extracted from OpenStreetMap and compiled into a shapefile format representing primary and secondary roads across Nigeria. This infrastructure inventory serves as exposure data for disaster risk assessment by identifying critical transportation assets that may be affected by hazards.
